title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Shares Sold by MCF Advisors LLC

organizations.name: mcf advisors llc mcf advisors llc

text:
MCF Advisors LLC lowered its holdings in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 46.6% during the third the company in its most recent Form 13F filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The firm owned 13,535 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 11,792 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for about 0.5% of MCF Advisors LLC’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 26th biggest position. MCF Advisors LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $3,055,000 as of its most recent SEC filing.
Other hedge funds and have also bought and sold shares of the company. Delphi Private Advisors LLC bought a new stake in Apple during the second quarter worth about $120,000. Selective Wealth Management bought a new stake in Apple during the third quarter worth about $194,000. Lawson Kroeker Investment Management Inc. NE bought a new stake in Apple during the third quarter worth about $201,000. Boston Standard Wealth Management LLC bought a new stake in Apple during the third quarter worth about $204,000. Finally, Leith Wheeler Investment Counsel Ltd. bought a new stake in Apple during the third quarter worth about $201,000. 57.00% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors and hedge funds.
